chunks: 4804 - And Muhammad ibn Muslim asked him about the waiting period of the mustahadah, so he said:

“She waits for the measure of her menstrual cycles, adding one day or subtracting one day. If she does not menstruate, then she should look to some of her women and observe her waiting period according to their menstrual cycles.”

key_terms.أَقْرَائِهَا: her menstrual cycles or periods used as the basis of calculation
key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: a woman experiencing irregular continuous bleeding outside normal menstruation
key_terms.تَنْتَظِرُ: she waits or calculates the period of waiting
key_terms.عِدَّةِ: the legal waiting period observed after divorce or similar circumstances
key_terms.فَلْتَعْتَدَّ: let her observe the legal waiting period accordingly

ai.seo_question: How is the waiting period of a mustahadah determined in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for determining the waiting period of a woman with irregular continuous bleeding. She is to estimate based on her usual menstrual pattern, with slight adjustment, and if that is unavailable, she refers to the cycles of comparable women.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4804 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam (as) about the waiting period of a mustahadah (a woman experiencing continuous bleeding).
Imam (as) said:

"She should wait for the duration of her usual menstrual cycles, adding a day or subtracting a day. If she does not menstruate, then she should look at the menstrual cycles of some of the women like her and observe her waiting period according to their cycles."
